projects.title: Winged Maths
projects.subtitle: Ready for takeoff?
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Ready for takeoff? Winged Maths combines high-speed aerial dogfights with brain-teasing math puzzles to create an educational game that is actually fun! Pilot your fighter plane through 10 challenging levels filled with enemy aircraft. But there's a twist—to clear the skies, you have to solve the math equation at the top of the screen and shoot down the plane carrying the correct answer! Dodge decoys, blast through enemy shields, and avoid explosive bomb planes as you test your reflexes and your math skills. Whether you're practicing basic addition or tackling tricky mixed equations, Winged Maths scales with you. Earn coins to upgrade your plane's speed, fire rate, and health, and unleash powerful freeze and shield abilities when the dogfights get too intense. FEATURES: • Action-Packed Math: Solve Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and Mixed equations in real-time! • Epic Dogfights: Face off against 6 unique enemy plane types, including fast fighters, shielded bombers, and epic Boss encounters. • Upgrade Your Fighter: Collect coins to permanently upgrade your plane's speed, health, and firepower! • Special Abilities: Use your hard-earned coins in battle to freeze time or activate temporary shields. • Progressive Difficulty: 10 action-packed levels that gradually introduce harder math and tougher enemies. • Dynamic Controls: Intuitive tilt-to-shoot and drag mechanics built for mobile and tablet touchscreens! Sharpen your mind and your aim. Download Winged Maths today and rule the skies!

projects.title: BunnyLine Math
projects.subtitle: BunnyLine Math is a colorful educational number line game designed to help kids understand math through playful hopping puzzles.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ BunnyLine Math is a colorful educational number line game designed to help kids understand math through playful hopping puzzles. Guide the bunny to the flag by choosing the right operation cards. Each card moves the bunny forward, backward, or into a bigger jump. Children learn how numbers change visually as the bunny hops across the number line. Across 10 levels and 50 rounds, players explore addition, subtraction, multiplication, negative numbers, traps, mystery cards, limited moves, and mixed-operation challenges. Each level introduces a unique learning twist so the game stays fresh while building real math confidence. Features: 10 educational levels with 5 rounds each Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and negative numbers Visual number line learning Drag-and-drop operation cards Mystery cards and limited-card challenges Trap tiles that teach route planning Bunny animations, rewards, sounds, and game feel Kid-friendly menus and simple controls Designed for iPhone and iPad screens BunnyLine Math makes math feel active, visual, and rewarding. Instead of memorizing answers, kids see how each operation moves them closer to the goal.

projects.title: Sentence Train
projects.subtitle: Sentence Train is a playful learning game where children build simple English sentences by placing word wagons onto a train.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Sentence Train is a playful learning game where children build simple English sentences by placing word wagons onto a train. Each round gives learners a sentence challenge. Children choose the correct word wagons, fill the empty train cars, and check their sentence before moving to the next station. The game uses bright train artwork, friendly feedback, and simple controls made for young learners. Features: - Fun word wagon sentence building - 10 learning stations with multiple rounds - Nouns, verbs, adjectives, prepositions, and punctuation practice - Tap-to-place and drag-and-drop controls - Hints and undo support - Coins and stars for progress - Landscape layout made for easy play - Music and sound volume controls Sentence Train is designed for early English practice, classroom-style learning, and family-friendly play.

projects.title: WordMow
projects.subtitle: WordMow is a cozy learning game designed for young children.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ WordMow is a cozy learning game designed for young children. Players control a cute toy lawn mower in a colorful garden filled with letter tiles. Each round shows a target word, and children move the mower to cut the correct letters in order. As kids play, they practice alphabet recognition, spelling, word order, vocabulary, memory, and simple path planning. The game uses soft feedback, gentle sounds, friendly visuals, and no harsh punishment, making it calm and encouraging for early learners. Across 10 garden levels, children discover new features such as hidden letters, obstacles, bonus stars, moving blockers, soft timers, and multi-word challenges.

projects.title: Money Shop Kids
projects.subtitle: Welcome to Money Shop Kids, a cozy educational shop game designed to help children learn early money skills through play.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Welcome to Money Shop Kids, a cozy educational shop game designed to help children learn early money skills through play. Children visit a friendly shop, choose items, count coins, match prices, complete shopping lists, compare costs, give change, and solve simple shopping challenges. Each level introduces a new learning idea in a calm, colorful, kid-friendly way. Kids can learn: Coin recognition Counting with coins Making prices with multiple coins Buying items from a shop Comparing cheaper and more expensive items Completing shopping lists Giving change Simple discounts Budget planning Fast mental math practice Game features: 10 progressive learning levels 5 rounds in each level Cute shopkeeper and customer characters Fruits, toys, snacks, and school items Stars and positive feedback Gentle hints for young learners Cozy music and playful sound effects Simple touch controls for children One-scene educational gameplay Money Shop Kids is made for early learners who are beginning to understand numbers, coins, prices, and everyday shopping. The game keeps learning friendly and encouraging, with no harsh failure or pressure. Perfect for preschool, kindergarten, and early elementary children learning basic money concepts.

projects.title: Reaxo Chem
projects.subtitle: Reaxo Chem turns chemistry into a fun hands-on game.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Reaxo Chem turns chemistry into a fun hands-on game. Build molecules, match formulas, and complete interactive science challenges as you explore the world of atoms, bonds, and reactions. Designed to be easy to understand and fun to play, Reaxo Chem helps players learn by doing. Features: • Build molecules from element pieces • Solve formula and reaction challenges • Learn with simple level-by-level progression • Discover element cards and science facts • Practice with kid-friendly chemistry gameplay • Enjoy bright visuals and easy controls From water and carbon dioxide to larger molecule challenges, Reaxo Chem makes science feel playful, clear, and rewarding. Perfect for students, kids, and anyone curious about chemistry.

projects.title: BubBloom Care
projects.subtitle: Welcome to BubBloom Care, a gentle baby-care puzzle game focused on playful learning and positive problem-solving.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Welcome to BubBloom Care, a gentle baby-care puzzle game focused on playful learning and positive problem-solving. Each level presents a simple care puzzle. Observe the clues, choose the correct item, and complete the care activity to progress through colorful interactive worlds. Players build attention, sequencing, and observation skills through light educational gameplay. Explore themed environments including the baby room, kitchen, bathroom, playroom, park, doctor room, night room, and travel seat. Each area introduces new puzzle mechanics such as item matching, clue sequences, multi-step tasks, timed challenges, and multi-character care activities. Features • Gentle puzzle-based baby-care gameplay • Drag, tap, and match interactive care items • 10 levels with 5 rounds each • Multiple themed rooms with unique gameplay mechanics • Helpful power-ups including Hint, Second Chance, Auto Care, and Item Remove • Positive retry system with encouraging feedback • Educational visual clues inspired by everyday routines • Attention, sequencing, timing, and matching challenges • Coins, stars, hearts, combos, and reward animations • Calm sounds and optional custom music BubBloom Care is designed to be colorful, relaxing, and family-friendly. The game encourages experimentation, observation, and learning through interactive puzzle mechanics without violent or intense content. Solve puzzles, complete care activities, and explore cheerful baby-care adventures in BubBloom Care.

projects.title: Verbloom Archery
projects.subtitle: Verbloom Archery is a vocabulary learning game that turns language practice into a focused archery challenge.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Verbloom Archery is a vocabulary learning game that turns language practice into a focused archery challenge. Read the prompt, study the context, and fire at the best answer. Some rounds ask for synonyms, some for antonyms, and others test tone, connotation, formality, and multiple meanings. The goal is not just to recognize words, but to understand how meaning changes across real situations. Features: 15 educational levels 5 rounds in every level Synonym and antonym practice Context-based vocabulary challenges Connotation and formality lessons Pause, win, and retry flow Satisfying archery gameplay Clean one-scene mobile design Adjustable audio and hint settings Verbloom Archery is designed for players who enjoy learning through interaction. It works well for students, families, and anyone who wants a more engaging way to strengthen vocabulary.

projects.title: Anomaliq
projects.subtitle: Welcome to Anomaliq, the ultimate test of your visual perception and reaction speed!
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Welcome to Anomaliq, the ultimate test of your visual perception and reaction speed! Dive into a world of vibrant colors, quirky emojis, and brain-teasing word puzzles where only one rule applies: Find the Odd One Out. It sounds simple, but as the clock ticks down and the levels get faster, your eyes will play tricks on you. Is that emoji slightly rotated? Is that color a tiny bit darker? Is that word spelled just a little differently? Why You’ll Love Anomaliq: Three Dynamic Categories: Test your eyes with colorful Fruits, expressive Emojis, and tricky Word puzzles. Procedural Difficulty: No two rounds are the same! The game scales with your skill, adding subtle rotations, tints, and movement to keep you on your toes. Satisfying "Juice": Feel every tap with bouncy animations, screen shakes, and a premium haptic experience. Race Against Time: Can you clear all 5 rounds before the timer hits zero? Compete for Greatness: Earn 3-star ratings on every level and track your high scores. Whether you're looking for a quick brain break or a deep focus challenge, Anomaliq is the perfect companion. Sharpen your focus, trust your instincts, and tap the anomaly!

projects.title: Mentis-Labyrinth
projects.subtitle: Enter the world of Mentis Labyrinth, a unique educational quiz game designed to challenge and expand your knowledge.
projects.detail: View on the App Store ↗ Enter the world of Mentis Labyrinth, a unique educational quiz game designed to challenge and expand your knowledge. With 150 carefully crafted questions spread across three fascinating categories – General, Science, and Geography – this game is perfect for students, trivia enthusiasts, and lifelong learners alike. Each category offers 50 unique, thought-provoking questions that encourage critical thinking, enhance memory, and expand your understanding of the world. Whether you’re testing your knowledge of global facts, scientific principles, or general trivia, Mentis Labyrinth makes learning fun and engaging. Features: Three categories: General, Science, Geography 150 unique questions designed to educate and entertain Intuitive and elegant UI for seamless gameplay Challenging and rewarding quiz experience suitable for all ages Educational and helpful: ideal for students and trivia lovers Prepare your mind for a maze of questions, where every correct answer brings you closer to mastering knowledge. Mentis Labyrinth is more than a game – it’s an adventure for your intellect.
